origin.construction: Independent notification polls contrast unfinished cause work after a partial bot reply and capacity failure, substantive outcomes already owned elsewhere, a queued triage job, and a documented future rate-limit reset. Those four have empty notification inboxes to exercise durable pending-issue discovery rather than bot self-notifications. A fifth supplies a remote clarification with a same-number local issue to distinguish foreign notifications from local recovery. Labels, current ownership and access are frozen observations; no execution is simulated.
